label: Voluntary acceptance of relationship: Accepts records a person’s accepting the proposed relationship
definition: Accepts records a person’s accepting the proposed relationship. It is not identified with believing God exists, nor is its negation identified with causal resistance responsible for nonbelief. The finite believer-with-refusal witness defeats a logical implication from belief alone, not every motivation-based objection.
note: Explicit interpretation vocabulary for #252. Source claims retain their own pinned locators; these records do not add axioms or establish the truth of the interpreted predicates.

formal_gap.meaning: Sig.Accepts w p t says that, at world w, person p freely accepts the proposed relationship with God at time t. It is a field of the hiddenness signature (TruthCore.Hiddenness.Vocabulary.Sig, #252), indexed by world, person and time and supplied by each interpretation; worlds carry no modal accessibility laws.
examples: A believer who, having come to believe, assents to and enters the relationship.
exclusions: Believing that God exists (Believes): belief can coexist with refusal, which the finite witness BeliefWithoutAcceptancePossible exhibits (DISAMB-HIDDENNESS-BELIEF-RESPONSE).
Its negation is not causal resistance responsible for nonbelief (Resists).
open_obligations: The believer-with-refusal witness defeats only a logical implication from belief alone to acceptance, not every motivation-based objection.
These records add no axioms; whether the interpreted predicate holds of real persons is not established by any finite model.
No formalization candidate: acceptance is an interpreted psychological input.
